patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I've been throwing up and my stomach hurts, and I can't stop breathing heavy and fast. I'm so thirsty and I'm peeing constantly. I ran out of my insulin a few days ago.
clinical.presentationShort: 19yo F with type 1 diabetes, out of insulin ? vomiting, abdominal pain, deep rapid breathing, fruity breath, thirst, polyuria, and dehydration.
clinical.presentationLong: 19-year-old female with type 1 diabetes who ran out of insulin several days ago. She has vomiting, abdominal pain, intense thirst, frequent urination, dehydration, fruity breath, and deep rapid respirations at 32/min.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → IV fluids, insulin infusion, potassium repletion, find the trigger; close monitoring.
diagnosis.why: Kussmaul breathing + fruity breath = DKA. Fluids first, then insulin, and watch the potassium.
diagnosis.redFlag: Deep rapid breathing + fruity breath + missed insulin = DKA.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 19-year-old woman, exhausted and dehydrated, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped, chest rising with deep fast breaths. Expression: worn out with dry, cracked lips. Clearly visible: deep labored breathing and a drained, dehydrated look. No text, no logos.
